name: pass without trace
lore:
# Pass Without Trace

To cast *Pass Without Trace* is to fold the world’s attention away from oneself. As the incantation settles, the air thickens with a cool, damp scent—reminiscent of rain-kissed moss. Visually, the subjects are wreathed in a subtle, shifting haze; shadows seem to stretch and cling to their heels, while the ground itself rises to instantly swallow every footprint or broken twig.

To the practitioner, shaping the Weave for this art feels like drawing a veil of silver silk over a guttering candle. It is a soft, rhythmic pulse, grounding the spirit into the very heartbeat of the terrain.

**The Legend of Elara the Silent**
It is whispered that the first to weave this veil was Elara, a wood-elf who sought to protect her kin from an ancient wyrm’s gaze. She spent decades studying the way mist clings to the valley floor until she could command the earth to forget she had ever stepped upon it. For any scout, this spell remains the difference between a ghost’s passage and a clumsy death.
